text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it, Dober's been in 
great shape lately!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh? Do you really think so...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It seems the three-legged race with 
her Trainer is really starting to hit its 
stride.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Y-You're exaggerating...! I do think the 
training suits me, sure, but—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Well... they make a training menu tailored 
to my situation, and encourage me whenever 
I start losing confidence—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Still, that's all it was! Seriously...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I-I was just thinking I've been in good 
shape lately, so...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...I guess my daily efforts paid off! The 
routine seems to suit me a bit, too.
choice_data_list: It's because Dober is working so hard.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I thought it might be partly thanks to 
you, Trainer, so... umm... Thank you.
choice_data_list: It's because Dober is working so hard.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
D-Doing my best is only natural, isn't 
it...! ...See ya!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'm counting on you from now on too, 
Trainer. ...Well, I'm off for a run.

With a slight blush on her face, Mejiro 
Dober ran off.
